scope: Six original Q4/Q9 plane-elastic fixtures; independent basis/weak-form assembly, loads and mesh supplied identically. No physical strength/fatigue qualification.

250 W steel spur qualification target
source.material_process: Catalog steel gears; supplier grade and heat treatment to be selected
source.lubrication: Enclosed lubricated housing; lubricant and quantity to be specified
source.standard_basis: Open analytical involute geometry and quasi-static statics; method external-involute-1. No standards-compliance claim.
source.notes: Development and qualification target, not an approved operating rating.

source.cutter_reference: Original numerical fixture: rounded symmetric rack, not a selected cutting tool.

source.material_reference: Invented isotropic elastic fixture, not supplier/material qualification.
source.support_basis: Invented plane-stress sector clamped on the 10 mm inner arc; cut sides traction-free. Numerical verification only.

cases.factor_basis: Synthetic full-mesh torque, uniform face width, smooth pressure patch; no measured dynamic or alignment factor.
